evidence_projection.method: structured source affected-system roll-up with record system-context fallback
evidence_projection.inference_boundary: Project affected provider, product, model, and runtime identity from structured system_or_product and model_or_algorithm source metadata. source_platform identifies the evidence host/publication surface and is not affected-system identity. Older records may use an existing concrete FM system_context as a bounded fallback. Do not infer system identity from narrative prose.

faceted_analysis.reporting_notes: Keep failure type, manifestation, cause, locus, repair responsibility, effect, severity and evidence state separate. Unknown is preferable to inferred precision.

failure_classification.severity_assessment_basis: State whether the rating relies on observed harm, demonstrated capability, or credible foreseeable harm, and identify the assessed deployment scope.
failure_classification.severity_assessment_gap: Identify the evidence, scope, or harm-pathway gap preventing a supported S0-S4 rating.

triage.triage_owner: REQUIRED — named analytical reviewer, actor, or routing authority
triage.triage_action_basis: Initial actionability and urgency assessment is incomplete.
triage.triage_assessment_gap: Identify what prevents current priority assessment.
triage.recommended_next_step: Complete severity, actionability, ownership, and routing assessment.

cam_internal.routing_note: FM routing may use affected_* fields because the record contains triage-relevant failure classification.

ecosystem_status.basis: State the evidence supporting the current external ecosystem state.

repair_status.verification_note: State what has and has not been verified.
